meta.name: SafeMeAI held-out evaluation set v1
meta.integrity: Authored from general knowledge of Indian fraud typologies and public advisories without reading the engines or the tuning benchmark. Frozen (SHA-256 recorded in docs/EVALUATION.md) before any run.

documents.text: STATE BANK OF INDIA, Retail Assets Hub, Pune. Date: 14-Oct-2026. Sanction Letter. Dear Mr. Sharma, we are pleased to inform you that a Home Loan of Rs 35,00,000 has been sanctioned subject to the terms below. Rate of interest: 8.65% p.a. floating linked to EBLR. Please sign and return the duplicate copy of this letter at your branch within 30 days. For any clarification, contact your branch or visit sbi.co.in. This sanction is valid for 90 days.

documents.text: RESERVE BANK OF INDIA. RBI/2025-26/45. DOR.CO.REG.No.12/2025-26. Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction. Regulated Entities are advised to carry out periodic updation of KYC at least once in every two years for high risk customers, eight years for medium risk and ten years for low risk customers. Customers may submit self-declaration of no change through registered email, mobile or ATM. This Direction is issued under Section 35A of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949.
